verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI documents speaker diarization that identifies individual speakers and labels each transcript segment with the speaker. The docs also list it as a supported async feature and give a meeting-transcription example with speaker labels and speaker identification by name. missing for 10: the exact request parameter and response schema for speaker labels are not shown in evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of diarization quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can request speaker diarization and the transcript labels who said what

citations.quote: Speaker diarization identifies individual speakers in your audio and labels each segment of the transcript with the speaker.
with support on speaker diarization, PII redaction, and more features
